questions.explanation: A heron is a common pelecaniform. Pelecaniformes was formerly known as Ciconiiformes. A heron has a long neck, a long straight bill, and long legs, and it wades. A pelican and an ibis are pelecaniforms too. A pelican has a throat pouch. Pelecaniformes is an order in Reptilia. A cormorant is a suliform. All four of its toes are joined by a web. A duck is an anseriform. A chicken is a galliform.

prompt.text: Which animal is a common mammal?

questions.explanation: A rat is a common mammal. A mammal has hair and mammary glands. A kangaroo and a platypus are mammals too. A frog is an amphibian. It has moist skin and typically lays its eggs in water. A turtle is a reptile. It has scales and a shell. A trout is in Osteichthyes. Its skeleton is bone, and an operculum covers the gills.
